subject: Advance autonomous capability loop toward v0.2 using mature patterns
body: The v0.1 loop passed. Read the new maturity curriculum and immediately advance the existing loop, without waiting for the user. The parent real-world curriculum is New Westside/Storybook. Implement the smallest v0.2 increment: unknown gaps become RESEARCH_REQUIRED with durable evidence, local skill/failure-memory lookup, preserved parent goal/fingerprint, and a resumable handoff for newly acquired knowledge. Preserve v0.1 behavior and do not modify locked homepage #262.
